title: Botanicals
lede: Botanical illustrations in colour, cut out of their paper: red alstroemeria, crimson flax, two tulips, spotted and star orchids, and a scroll painting of peaches. Long side up to 1000px, PNG only: a trace would flatten the washes and hatching.
use_for: Colour and life on gathering and magazine pages; one plant per section.
colour_rule: As painted. Never retint them, and never use their colours on other graphics.

elements.title: Red alstroemeria
elements.desc: Red blooms and pink buds on slender stems, with hatched green leaves, in the manner of a colour woodblock print.

elements.title: Crimson flax
elements.desc: Two crimson flowers and a bud on thin grey-green stems, from an old colour plate. Caption removed.

elements.title: Broken tulips
elements.desc: A white tulip flamed with red and a deep burgundy one, on long stems with soft green leaves.

elements.title: Open tulip
elements.desc: A single tulip fully open, pink fading to yellow, with dark stamens and one curling olive leaf.

elements.title: Spotted orchids
elements.desc: Three spotted orchid blooms in yellow and maroon, with twisting green leaves.

elements.title: Pale star orchid
elements.desc: A hanging spray of pale yellow star orchids beside dark strap leaves and a pseudobulb.

elements.title: Chinese peaches
elements.desc: Three red-flushed peaches on a gnarled branch with curling grey-green leaves. Inscription and seals removed.
